snippets.title: Madhu Guru on agents and models
snippets.takeaway: Prompt debt is the new tech debt. With every model update, you should be cutting at least 50% of your prompts.
snippets.summary: Madhu Guru (realmadhuguru on X) shared 2 recent updates. Prompt debt is the new tech debt. With every model update, you should be cutting at least 50% of your prompts. Most AI products have bloated prompts that are making your product quality worse. The typical flow is: model fails at something -> add 10 rules. Tool call fails -> add 10 examples. Output is weird -> add formatting constraints. 3 months later, your system prompt is a novel.
